relations.text: 買収で合意したが、当局の審査を受けて2025年12月に契約を解除
relations.text_en: Agreed to buy it but terminated the agreement in December 2025 after the regulatory review

source.quote: On December 26, 2025, we delivered a notice to terminate our definitive agreement to acquire AccuLynx

companies.name: スライド・インシュアランス

relations.text: 引受に使う独自データのライセンスをLexisNexisやVeriskに依存
relations.text_en: Relies on licensed proprietary data from LexisNexis and Verisk

source.label: Slide Insurance 10-K(2026年提出)
source.quote: should LexisNexis or Verisk refuse to license their proprietary information to us on the same terms that it offers to our competitors

relations.text: TransUnionが10-Kで、保険分野の競合としてVeriskを挙げる
relations.text_en: TransUnion names Verisk as its competitor in the insurance vertical

source.label: TransUnion 10-K(2025年提出)
source.quote: with Verisk Analytics, Inc. in the Insurance vertical

relations.text: RELXが年次報告で、保険のデータ分析の競合としてVeriskを挙げる
relations.text_en: RELX names Verisk as a data and analytics competitor in insurance

source.label: Relx 年次報告(20-F)(2026年提出)
source.quote: In Insurance, data and analytics competitors such as Verisk sell solutions to insurance carriers

relations.text: Soleraが上場届出書で、整備・修理ソリューションの主な競合としてVeriskを挙げる
relations.text_en: Solera names Verisk among principal competitors for its service and repair solutions
